key_impacts: Large quantity of radioactive material released into the environment.
Over three hundred thousand residents evacuated from the vicinity of the plants.
Large stretches of land rendered uninhabitable.
Cleanup will take decades and may cost tens, if not hundreds, of billions of dollars.
Tsunami inundation caused failure of emergency power systems and a station blackout.
